observations.behavior: Adds a note clarifying that the Groups resource covers three group operations, and the other two are not given their own tables. P1.F3.H4
observations.code_quote: Note: `Groups` covers all three group operations. `/v1/mgmt/group/all` returns each group with its `members` array already attached, so `/v1/mgmt/group/members` and `/v1/mgmt/group/member/all` only re-return filtered views of the same rows and were not given tables of their own.
